title: Q-LOOP-live-clock: Run Ultrastable's own seed heartbeat on a deployed runtime and report it
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** file:instances/ultrastable/live-runtime.json
**Status:** done

Gap in component `self-host`: the local self-host tick passes (python3 -m foundation selfhost) but no deployed runtime of Ultrastable's own seed reports a tick. ultrastable.io/health is the site worker only. Record the runtime URL and its first reported tick in instances/ultrastable/live-runtime.json. Deploy the seed worker with instances/ultrastable/objectives.json seeded, add its /health URL to doctrine/detectors.json as a detector, and register M-site-up style http metrics against it. Requires the Cloudflare route in deploy/routes.json; an unavailable credential is a recorded failure with a staged default, not a wait.

**Evidence:** instances/ultrastable/live-runtime.json records two deployed runtimes; /health reports tick 461 (8/8 steps) for both on 2026-11-15; detectors runtime-tenant0 and runtime-child watch them; /dashboard live feed reads them on load.
